references.text: Sisera fled on foot to Jael's tent, which explains why Jael went out to meet him
Jael used the blanket she covered Sisera with to hide him before killing him with a tent peg
Deborah's song describes Jael's action of welcoming Sisera and offering him hospitality before killing him
Abraham went out to meet his guests by the terebinths of Mamre, a similar expression of Eastern hospitality
Lot invited the angels into his house and offered them hospitality, just as Jael invited Sisera
Rahab hid the spies on the roof, a similar theme where a woman hides fugitives
The phrase 'do not be afraid' is used here as a reassurance, just as Jael assured Sisera
